title: George faced tons of backlash getting people to switch over to digital. Even internally for a while at ILM they called it "The Dark Side". This clip is from Season 2 ep. 2 of Lights & Magic.
author: _stevencasteel_

comments.author: _stevencasteel_
comments.body:
Everybody else was just very down on it.

Because it changed everything.

It means you had to relearn what you had learned.

But I kept saying, you know, it's so much easier.

You can do anything.

If it's quicker and faster and better and it's more malleable

and you can do more stuff with it and it's cheaper,

you know, why not?

Because we all are faced with this resource issue.

You know, how much money they give us to make these things.

It's so much easier to do the things you want to do.
